summary.headline: Syromacedonian Calendar Reconstruction
summary.text: Discussion of the Syromacedonian calendar under Augustus, comparing its months with the Roman calendar and correcting the month-name and date readings. A reconstructed sequence lists Sebastos, Agrippaios, Libaios, Oktabaios, Ioulaios, Neronaios, Drousaios, Aphrodisios, Anchisaios, Romaios, Aineadaios, and Kapetolios with their dates and lengths.
